description: This file defines CSS styles and variables for a responsive blog platform, managing both light and dark themes along with styles for various components such as the app logo, header, links, and a theme toggle button.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container for the application, utilizing theme colors and managing layout.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styling for the application logo, includes animation properties.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header styling for the application with layout and theme management.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styling for application links to ensure they adopt theme colors.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the button that toggles between light and dark themes.
